report:
# FQ-U1-TRANSPORT-N-TORSION

On one fixed graph with four vertices and five oriented edges (cycle rank2), enumerate all Z/N edge labels, remove the declared spanning-tree gauge and retain both chord invariants. Arbitrary vertex repairs preserve them; all N² invariant pairs occur for retained N<=4. The source ConnectednessShadow only means not exponent two: finite C3/C4 pass it. It is not topological connectedness or selection of U(1).

Supported: Actual finite graph gauge normal forms, relative path phase and N² orbit-invariant counts are exact; cycle identities over ZMod n and pair-cardinality arithmetic are kernel checked.

Remaining: Prove full graph gauge-orbit classification and the cyclotomic mu_N embedding/order hypotheses for arbitrary graphs/N; no continuous circle or topological connectedness is derived.
